CustomField.description: Difference between the component line's allocated per-user total and its per-user gross list price (Total Per User Per SKU - Bundle Price). Null on the bundle root line and until the allocation flow has run.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(ParentQuoteLineItemId), ISBLANK(Total_Per_User_Per_SKU__c), ISBLANK(Bundle_Price_Display__c) ), null, Total_Per_User_Per_SKU__c - Bundle_Price_Display__c )
CustomField.label: Adjustment Per SKU
